main_reasons: Simple, mostly recurring licensing revenue model with transparent disaggregation and cash flow from operations (7.7M) well above net income (1.5M)
Large Big-firm-affiliated auditor (Baker Tilly) clean opinion, no critical audit matters, no restatement flags or auditor changes
Pending all-cash acquisition by Evolution at $3.20/share reduces incentive to manage earnings; strategic buyer due diligence
Minor flags: accounts receivable and unbilled receivables up ~22%/44% while revenue fell 2.7%; Client B receivable jumped from 0.2M to 1.0M
Unaccrued potential sales/use tax liability from self-identified compliance gap; gross-vs-net royalty judgment on licensed content
Small OTCQB company with no auditor ICFR attestation, thin finance staff, no formal code of ethics, stockholders' deficit and leverage-based covenants
